mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.0% signals labor market weakness, prompting Federal Reserve rate cuts that boost equity valuations and produce positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 7.0 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent industrial production decline (INDPRO < 100) and inflation acceleration (CPIAUCSL > 232.0) indicate stagflation risk, triggering Fed policy uncertainty and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100 and CPIAUCSL > 232.0 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, housing starts decline below 1000.0 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1000.0 during late-cycle expansion (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Employment level above 135000 thousand persons indicates robust labor market strength, supporting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 135000 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Core inflation exceeding 232.0 (CPIAUCSL > 232.0) signals accelerating price pressures, prompting Federal Reserve tightening that increases equity discount rates and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 232.0 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous retail sales decline (RSAFS < 420000) and industrial production contraction (INDPRO < 100) indicate broad economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS < 420000 and INDPRO < 100 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, federal funds rate exceeding 0.15% signals aggressive policy, increasing borrowing costs and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 0.15 during monetary tightening cycles (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).
